sources.title: Wang Lab
sources.snippet: Welcome We are a discovery-driven research group working at the interface between organismal biology, bioengineering, and statistical physics. We combine quantitative imaging, functional genomics, and physical modeling to understand the fundamental rules that control collective cell behaviors to optimize tissue regeneration, adaptation, and evolution.
